title.narrative: Coordination and Partnership in Tripoli Antenna

description.narrative: UNESCO and Libya enjoy a long-standing cooperation involving the design and implementation of a large number of programmes financed from voluntary contributions from the Government of Libya as well as other donors. Further to an extended period in which many of the projects financed by Libya were placed on hold, an effort is underway by the Libyan authorities and UNESCO to re-activate and relaunch the cooperation to progress on the 2030 Agenda and the SDG’s. In 2019, the UNESCO Office for the Maghreb based in Rabat was assigned responsibility for cooperation with Libya. The establishment of Coordination and Partnership in Tripoli Antenna with the funds from “Running cost-the Tripoli Office-664LIB50001”, under the overall supervision and support of the UNESCO Regional Office for the Maghreb based in Rabat, is to facilitate day-to-day engagement and foster partnerships with key national and international stakeholders based in Libya including the donor community. It will enable coordination with different UNCTs to foster joint programming, partnership and joint projects. The incumbent will also identify funding opportunities outside the UN system with traditional and non-traditional donors. The person coordinating will be in charge of following the outcome and outputs of the joint activities and synergies within different UNCTs and of the regular and extra budgetary programs of UNESCO as well as the regular reporting to UNESCO, the UN and Government planning institutes. It will facilitate the on-going process of reactivating programmes financed by Libya as well as the identification of new large-scale impactful programmes, and resource mobilization to scale up collaboration between UNESCO and Libya as well as to strengthen UNESCO’s presence. It will also facilitate UNESCO participation within the wider United Nations Country Team in Libya and foster the operationalization of UNESCO’s mandate within the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) for Libya for 2023-2025. The establishment of a UNESCO Antenna in Tripoli for Libya is also in line with the Agreed Management Actions (AMA) outlined in the recent 2023 audit on the UNESCO Regional Office for the Maghreb, which recommends that “the Office should develop a strategy defining its programme priorities in line with the five countries’ needs and a corresponding resource mobilization plan” and to support the Office in managing its presence in countries where UNESCO is not a resident agency, the Office for the Maghreb is deploying efforts to enhance the Organization’s presence in Libya. Therefore, the re-activation of the project “Running cost-the Tripoli Office-664LIB50001” will contribute to the achievement of the following outcome: Ensure implementation of UNESCO’s mandate in all areas of competencies including Education, Natural and Human Sciences, Culture as well as Communication and Information in Libya.
